✓ Ancient Greece.fact: == Politics and society == === Political structure === Ancient Greece consisted of several hundred relatively independent city-states (poleis).  This was a situation unlike that in most other contemporary societies, which were either tribal or kingdoms ruling over relatively large territories.  Undoubtedly, the geography of Greece—divided and sub-divided by hills, mountains, and rivers—contributed to the fragmentary nature of ancient Greece.
